verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs describe autonomous agents that read files, edit code, and run commands across the editor, terminal, and browser. They also cover isolated Git worktrees, a headless CLI mode for CI pipelines, and MCP connections to external APIs. Together these could plausibly be assembled into an issue-to-PR flow, but no first-party issue-tracker or pull-request integration is documented. missing for 10: native ingestion of tracked issues (GitHub/Jira/etc.), automated branch commit and PR creation, a documented end-to-end issue-to-PR workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
